hotel: StumarOS demo hotel (mock data for HW1)

sections.text: Breakfast is served 07:00-10:30 daily in the ground-floor café and is included in all room rates.
The rooftop pool is open 08:00-22:00. It is closed outside these hours with no exceptions. No glassware; children under 12 must be supervised.
Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Late check-out until 13:00 can be requested at reception for 20 GEL, subject to availability. Departures after 13:00 are charged as an extra night.
Wi-Fi network: StumarGuest. The password is printed on the sleeve of your room key card.
The hotel has no on-site parking. The nearest public garage is 300 m away and costs 3 GEL per hour; the hotel cannot reserve spaces.
Rooms are cleaned daily between 10:00 and 15:00. Extra towels, pillows, blankets and toiletries are free on request and delivered within 30 minutes.
Report leaks, air-conditioning, door lock or electrical problems to reception at any time. Urgent issues are handled within 15 minutes, 24/7.
Quiet hours are 22:00-08:00. Parties and gatherings in rooms are not permitted.
Pets are not allowed, with the exception of registered assistance animals.
